findings.title: Unnecessary internal details in a public error response
findings.severity_rationale: In the training scenario, internal paths and component details are exposed without authentication; no sensitive records or access gain were demonstrated.
findings.description: A synthetic error-response fixture includes an internal path and application component names. The training analyst marked this finding confirmed after reviewing the fixture. This status describes the exercise only.
validation_steps: 2026-10-14T14:00:00-04:00: reviewed the synthetic application response fixture.
Compared the response against the training requirement that public errors contain only a correlation ID.
findings.business_impact: In an actual deployment, unnecessary implementation details could aid reconnaissance. The demonstration does not establish access to client records or an exploitation chain.
findings.remediation: Configure the application error handler to return a generic message and correlation ID. Keep diagnostic paths and stack traces in access-controlled application logs. Add regression coverage for unauthenticated error responses.
retest_steps: In an authorized test environment, trigger the same error and verify the response contains only the generic message and correlation ID.
Confirm authorized operators can still correlate the ID with protected diagnostic logs.
